passages.title: BC Greens Plan Free Childcare Expansion and Name Greater Victoria Candidate (West Coast Current)
passages.quote: Lowan noted that the strategy includes establishing a centralized registration system to eliminate individual waiting lists, reducing administrative hurdles for operators, and building long-lasting facilities. To support the childcare workforce, the party proposes introducing paid practicums alongside a dedicated wage grid. Under the plan, early childhood educator wages would reach $35 to $45 per hour by 2028, backed by access to extended health benefits and pension plans. Lowan emphasized that public investments in early childhood care generate economic returns by enabling parents to rejoin the workforce.
